description: AirRun: helicopter and private-jet runs. Whether the Air Run is paused, the daily cap, and the latest runs: runs taking applications (with the window end and the applicant count), seat lotteries and flights waiting for their drand draw (with the winning application once drawn), and finished ones with the outcome (won, lost, expired, void). Pass wallet for its flight status, cooldown and claimable winnings. Take a run with prepare_air_run. Read only.

n.description: How many of the latest runs, 1 to 30 (default 12).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: get_air_runs
